profile_text.body:
Pony AI Inc. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou that trades under the ticker PONY. On its website, the company describes itself as a global autonomous driving technology company founded in 2016 in Silicon Valley. It says it is developing autonomous driving technology built around a core system it calls a "virtual driver," organized into three business units: Robotaxi, Robotruck, and Personally Owned Vehicles (POV). The company states it has secured licenses and credentials to test and operate autonomous driving vehicles in multiple locations worldwide, and that its vehicles had traveled over 32 million kilometers (over 13 million miles) on urban roads and highways as of April 2024.

The site presents the company as pursuing commercialization of autonomous driving across passenger travel and commercial logistics, and as a pioneer extending autonomous mobility technologies and services at an expanding footprint of sites around the world. It says the company has accumulated millions of kilometers in autonomous road testing in complex scenarios, including difficult weather and road conditions, which it describes as groundwork for scalable autonomous driving products and services.

The company's own materials do not list specific product names beyond the three business units. No lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for it.
